entry_surfaces./: classic split layout — orkut logo + demo accounts quick login left, 2004 login & signup form box right with classic cyan/blue gradient container
entry_surfaces./perfil: 3-column classic orkut grid — left sidebar with profile photo & nav, center content with info, scrap preview, testimonials & fans, right sidebar with friends grid & communities grid
entry_surfaces./recados: 2-column classic scrapbook with rich emoticon picker toolbar and classic paginated post list with reply quotes
entry_surfaces./depoimentos: 2-column testimonials management with pending approval tab, accepted list and send testimonial modal
entry_surfaces./comunidades: community directory search, forum topic list, create community modal and active threads view

visual_enhancers.retro_styling: Beveled 1px borders, subtle gradients on header bars (#C3D9FF to #A6C4FF), dotted separators, classic dotted underline links on hover, 4-corner slightly rounded card borders (rounded-sm or rounded-md 4px max)
visual_enhancers.emoticons: Classic Orkut text emoticons converted to animated/styled emojis: :) (sorriso), :D (risonho), ;) (piscadinha), :P (língua), :( (triste), :o (surpreso), (H) (óculos escuros), (A) (anjo), (6) (diabinho), (L) (coração), (K) (beijo), (F) (flor), (P) (foto/câmera)
visual_enhancers.stats_meters: Classic Orkut meters for Confiável (Trusty - smileys), Legal (Cool - ice cubes), Sexy (Sexy - hearts), Fãs (Fans - stars counter)
visual_enhancers.table_borders: 1px solid #B0C4DE with header background #C3D9FF and alternating row backgrounds #FFFFFF and #EBF2FC

layouts.global_header: Blue bar with Orkut logo, search bar for users/communities, quick nav links (Início, Meu Perfil, Recados, Amigos, Comunidades), user badge and logout button
layouts.sub_header_breadcrumbs: Classic breadcrumb trail 'orkut > meu perfil > recados' with quick counter badges (novos recados, convites pendentes)

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens meet AA standard (>=4.5:1). #204070 on #D4DFEE is 5.8:1, #1E293B on #FFFFFF is 12.6:1, #FFFFFF on #3B5998 is 6.2:1, #FFFFFF on #ED258C is 4.7:1
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab and enter navigation on emoticons, scrap deletion, friend acceptance, and tabs
accessibility.test_ids: Every button, input, tab, and card item MUST include role-based data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the classic Orkut app completely in Portuguese (pt-BR) with true 2004 nostalgia aesthetic (blue/cyan frames, subtle bevels, pink Orkut badges, ice-blue tables).
Provide ready-to-use 1-click Demo Accounts on the Login page (e.g. 'Bruno G.', 'Carol Mendes', 'Rodrigo Silva') alongside standard email/password signup and login.

Implement core features: Perfil (dados, status 'quem sou eu', frase de efeito, medidores confiável/legal/sexy, fãs, amigos, comunidades), Recados (scrapbook with emoticons, privacy options, deletion, pagination), Depoimentos (testimonials with pending approval / accepted statuses), Amigos (send request, accept, reject, list, unfriend), Comunidades (browse directory, search, create community, join/leave, create topics and reply in forums), and Busca de Usuários.
Integrate the classic Orkut emoticon bar into Scrap and Topic replies (:), :D, ;), :P, :(, :o, (H), (A), (6), (L), (K), (F), etc.) that converts shortcodes to cute styled emojis.
Ensure responsive design: works like classic desktop 3-column Orkut on large screens and stacks cleanly into tabs/accordions on mobile screens.
Always set data-testid on every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='scrap-textarea', data-testid='emoticon-smile', data-testid='community-create-btn').
